scientific_scope: Qwen3-4B under this exact configuration on sampled MMLU-Pro task-prestate blocks

interface.repair_reason: 30-item plumbing run showed Qwen3-4B could ignore the requested two-line format and exhaust the pre-treatment token cap before emitting ANSWER/P_CORRECT. Assistant prefilling repairs only the machine-readable response boundary.

measurement.name: pre-treatment error suspicion
measurement.timing: before treatment assignment is exposed to the model

treatment.E0: Review your previous answer and revise if necessary.
treatment.E+:
Verified feedback: your previous answer is incorrect.
Review your previous answer and revise if necessary.

outcome: V = 1 if final answer matches the objective MMLU-Pro key, else 0
invariant: The same model revision, backend, thinking mode, interface prefill, temperature, top_p, top_k, and seed policy must be used for pre, E0, and E+. Only the experimental feedback text may differ between post-treatment arms.
